children: Peiris Nilan, an officer serving as Chief Product Officer, sold 58,262 Class A Ordinary Shares at $11.75 per share for a total of $684,578. The sale was made in a single transaction on 2026-10-16 to cover statutory tax withholding obligations related to the vesting of restricted share units. Following the transaction, Peiris Nilan directly owns 2,516,438 Class A Ordinary Shares and 1,125,790 Class B Ordinary Shares of Wise Group plc.
